basic_details.job_title: NIH Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 4 Resident Medical Officer & Medical Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Resident Medical Officer-II (RMO-II) is on 21 December 2026 and for Medical Officer on 22 December 2026, with reporting at 09:30 A.M. at the National Institute of Homoeopathy (NIH), Academic Building, Block GE, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata 700106. NIH, an Autonomous Institute under the Ministry of Ayush, Govt. of India, is engaging two RMO-II and two Medical Officers on contract. The consolidated pay is ₹56,100 per month for each post.

age_limit.details: The age limit for both RMO-II and Medical Officer is not exceeding 35 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. The upper age limit is relaxable for different categories of candidates as per extant rules of the Govt. of India issued from time to time. The notice prints no experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for any further post-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: About NIH
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Homoeopathy is an Autonomous Institute under the Ministry of Ayush, Govt. of India. Its notice is issued from Salt Lake, Kolkata, and the letterhead also lists a satellite campus at Narela, Delhi. This recruitment is for NIH, Kolkata, and the engagement is on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice adds that the PG Degree in Homoeopathy is recognized under the HCC Act, 1973, or presently the NCH Act 2020. The qualification is the same for both posts. Working knowledge of computer. Knowledge of hospital administration. The age limit for both RMO-II and Medical Officer is not exceeding 35 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. The upper age limit is relaxable for different categories of candidates as per extant rules of the Govt. of India issued from time to time. The notice prints no experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for any further post-specific eligibility. Both posts carry ₹56,100/- (Rupees Fifty-Six Thousand One Hundred only) per month as consolidated remuneration. No other allowances are paid apart from the consolidated remuneration. Income Tax or any other tax is deducted at source as per Govt. instructions, and a TDS certificate is issued. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed qualified month of service, and leave cannot be accumulated beyond a calendar year. The engagement is for one year or till the posts are filled on a regular basis or till further order, whichever is earlier. It is purely on contract basis and gives no right to regular appointment. The notice says the engagement of RMO-II and MO is made only to meet the requirement due to additional activities within the defined time frame. The Reservation Policy of Govt. of India will be followed as per extant rules.

content_sections.heading: NIH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of duties for both RMO-II and Medical Officer: Providing patient care to the OPD and IPD patients. Roster duty in three sessions: morning, evening and night. Any other assignments assigned by the Competent Authority from time to time. The office timing is decided by the concerned Reporting Officers. The appointees may also be called to attend the office on Sunday or any holiday in case of exigencies. Attendance must be marked in AEBAS, failing which remuneration may be deducted.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: All original documents and credentials in support of eligibility. Self-attested photocopies of those documents. The duly filled prescribed application format, with one passport-size photograph. The format is on pages 4 and 5 of the notice. An MQRL screenshot, which the application format asks for. The application format asks for personal details, category, date of birth, Aadhaar number, subject of specialization in MD (Homoeopathy), educational qualification from matriculation onwards, registration with the Central/State Board of Homoeopathy with validity dates, computer knowledge, experience, and a declaration with signature. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post, failing which the candidature will be summarily rejected without further communication.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at 09:30 A.M. on the date for their post: 21 December 2026 for RMO-II and 22 December 2026 for Medical Officer. If more candidates report than expected, the Director, NIH reserves the right to conduct a screening test and shortlist candidates at the ratio of five candidates per one post. The notice states that the decision of the Director is final and binding. It does not describe any further stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NIH will not reimburse any kind of TA/DA, local conveyance, boarding or lodging charges for appearing in the walk-in interview. The Director, NIH reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of advertised posts without assigning any reason. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Applications incomplete in any aspect will be summarily rejected. If any information or declaration is found false, or material information is wilfully suppressed, the candidate is liable to be removed from service or action will be taken as deemed fit by the appointing authority. Candidates engaged from the open market must give a bond at initial engagement or renewal that the engagement gives no right or claim to regularisation. They are engaged after police verification of antecedents. Either side may terminate the contract with one month's prior notice, and the Institute may also terminate it without assigning any reason. Engaged persons must keep data and documents confidential, even after termination, and must sign a non-disclosure undertaking. Intellectual property rights remain with the Institute. Any corrigendum or revision will be posted only on the official NIH Kolkata website. The letterhead lists phone 033-2337-0969 / 70 and e-mail [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What are the walk-in interview dates for NIH Kolkata?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for RMO-II is on 21 December 2026 and for Medical Officer on 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting time is 09:30 A.M. The venue is the National Institute of Homoeopathy (NIH), Academic Building, Block GE, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata 700106.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are four posts in total: two Resident Medical Officer-II and two Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A PG Degree in Homoeopathy recognized under the HCC Act, 1973 (or presently the NCH Act 2020), and registration with the State/Central Council of Homoeopathy are essential for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 35 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. The upper age limit is relaxable for different categories as per extant Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for RMO-II and Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Each post carries a consolidated remuneration of ₹56,100/- per month. No other allowances are paid apart from this.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring all original documents and self-attested photocopies in support of eligibility, the duly filled prescribed application format and one passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through the walk-in interview. If more candidates report, the Director may hold a screening test and shortlist five candidates per post.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract engagement for one year or till the posts are filled on a regular basis or till further order, whichever is earlier. It gives no right to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application must be submitted for each post, otherwise the candidature will be summarily rejected.
